name: memblame
description: Find the commit and the function that made your Python code use more memory. Compares memory across git commits and maps growth to the lines that changed.

commands.title: Compare Memory: Working Tree vs HEAD
Analyze Memory Over a Commit Range…
Find the Commit That Increased Memory (bisect)…

memblame.workload.markdownDescription: What to run at each commit: `pytest:tests/test_big.py::test_load`, `script:bench/run.py --n 10` or `call:package.module:function`. A script path may be absolute (outside the repo), which keeps the workload identical across commits. Also read automatically from `memblame.toml` or `[tool.memblame]` in `pyproject.toml`.

memblame.runs.markdownDescription: Maximum measured runs per commit (the median is reported). Leave unset to use `runs` from the repository's memblame.toml / [tool.memblame], else 3.

memblame.nframe.markdownDescription: Traceback depth used for attribution; increase it if the report notes truncated stacks. Leave unset to use `nframe` from the repository's memblame.toml / `[tool.memblame]`, else 16.

memblame.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Interpreter that runs **your** code (it needs your project's dependencies). Precedence: this setting → `python` in the repository's memblame.toml / `[tool.memblame]` → the interpreter selected in the Python extension → `.venv`/`venv` in the repository → `python3`.

memblame.importPaths.markdownDescription: Directories (relative to the repo) to import your project from, e.g. `src`. Leave empty to use `pythonpath` from the repository's config, else auto-detect.

memblame.defaultRange.description: Default commit range for 'Analyze Memory Over a Commit Range'.

memblame.testCodeLens.description: Show a 'Memory vs HEAD' CodeLens above pytest test functions.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: MemBlame runs your project's code (tests, scripts, functions) to measure memory, so it only works in trusted workspaces.
